name: Digital Nomad Program (Ministry of Industry and Trade)

requirements.blocker_text: Restricted to citizens of Australia, Japan, Canada, South Korea, New Zealand, Taiwan, the United States, and the United Kingdom (per the tier-1 embassy source reviewed). Tier-3 commentary describes a February 2025 expansion adding Brazil, Israel, Mexico, and Singapore, plus marketing specialists as an eligible profession -- this expansion was NOT independently confirmed at tier-1 in this pass.
Minimum income of CZK60,530/month, described as 1.5 times the average gross salary (a figure that will drift as the average-salary reference updates).
requirements.fix_path: Increase documented qualifying income to the current threshold.

requirements.blocker_text: Must remain in an employment relationship with a foreign company (remote work only) or operate as a freelancer under a Czech trade licence -- entering into a Czech employment relationship is disqualifying.

evidence_required.document: Proof of qualifying foreign employment or Czech trade licence

outcome.duration_length: 1-year visa, renewable via reapplication before expiry, convertible into a long-term residence permit

sources.title: Czech Embassy Seoul -- Czech Government Fast-track Visa Program 'Digital Nomad': eligible nationalities, CZK60,530/month income threshold, foreign-employment-only restriction, 1-year visa, 2-stage processing

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Czechia's initial build. Officially in force since 2023, jointly run by the Ministry of Industry and Trade (programme approval, ~1 week) and Ministry of Foreign Affairs (visa issuance, up to 45 days). Confirmed directly at tier-1 (Czech embassy page). The programme covers two legal tracks: remote employees of foreign companies, and freelancers operating under a Czech trade licence (zivnostensky list) -- both administered under this same fast-track programme rather than as separate routes. Tier-3 sources (Fragomen, Citizen Remote) describe a February 2025 nationality expansion (adding Brazil, Israel, Mexico, Singapore) and an added 'marketing specialist' eligible profession, plus a claim that the visa converts into a 2-year residence permit for up to 3 years total stay -- none of this was independently confirmed at tier-1 in this pass, so the nationality list here is kept to the 8 countries the tier-1 source explicitly names. family_can_join set false: not addressed in the source reviewed.
